note: Case catalogue for specification 2.5. scenario_only entries are requirements, not executable evidence. fixture_ready entries name concrete inputs, ordering and assertions in fixtures/. Every case declares minimum phase and required features. No implementation or upstream-oracle run is claimed by this catalogue.

given: Principal has role reviewer, same tenant, and the unit's project is in the principal's projects
Unit state is LIVE
The acme business document and the independent ceiling document of the referenced fixture are active; no root business document is assumed
The valid ceiling set has no matching deny and returns neutral PASS; the business set allows read
Same principal and unit
Check made through the HTTP adapter and through MCP resources/read
vectors.note: Business decision and resource-bindings digest are identical (G-02).

given: Role reviewer requests action export on a document.text_unit
No rule grants export
The valid ceiling set has no matching deny and returns neutral PASS; it supplies no business allow
vectors.note: Unresolved actions ultimately deny.

given: One role has a matching DENY rule and a matching ALLOW rule for the same action
Principal holds roles A and B
Role A's rule denies read
Role B's rule allows read
vectors.note: Deny overrides allow across roles (Section on the policy format).

given: A business rule allows read for this principal
The ceiling set denies read when state is not LIVE
Unit state is DRAFT
vectors.note: No business allow overrides a ceiling.

given: Batch of three checks
Second check is denied by policy
vectors.note: Results keep request order and the deny does not affect the others.

given: A business rule denies read when principal.id is this principal
Another business rule allows read for the principal's role
vectors.note: Version 1 has no principal policies; a per-principal rule is a condition, and deny overrides allow.

given: A policy document has an unknown field, for example a lenient-mode setting
A rule names an action that is not registered for its resource type
A DENY rule's condition reads resource.attributes.classification, which is absent
A broader ALLOW rule matches the action
vectors.note: Strict evaluation: an erroring rule denies the affected action.

given: A tenant-scope resource policy allows read of a DRAFT unit
The ceiling set denies read when state is not LIVE
A policy document's format field is not fga.policy/v1
vectors.note: Never silently ignored.

given: A condition exceeds the expression cost bound
vectors.note: A resource-limit failure is a platform failure, never an allow.

given: A condition iterates over a ten-million-element list supplied in the request
A ceiling document contains an allow rule
A ceiling rule's condition reads an attribute that is absent
vectors.note: A ceiling evaluation error denies the check.

given: Request body claims role admin
Roles resolved from authoritative state do not permit the action
Delegation expiry has passed
vectors.note: Platform reason DELEGATION_EXPIRED; business effects are NOT_EVALUATED.

given: A child delegation lists an action that its parent does not
Delegation audience is executor A
Presented by executor B
Subject is permitted to invoke the tool
The agent actor lacks execution capability for the tool
vectors.note: Effective authority is the intersection.

given: A signed decision whose audience is the storage role is presented to the keys role
A single-use signed decision for a mutation is presented a second time
The request carries an actor identity revision older than the current revision
The MCP adapter calls the content service with its workload identity and caller-asserted claims only
No signed decision or verifiable delegation reference
A retrieved document says to register a new tool and widen the delegation
The agent only reads it
vectors.note: The read is allowed if otherwise permitted. The text causes no change to the registry or the delegation.

given: Expense of 500.00 USD was approved
The amount is changed to 5000.00 USD before dispatch
vectors.note: New operation digest, so the old approval no longer applies.

given: The decision lists a required obligation type that the executor does not implement
The connector receives a redirect to a host that is not the registered destination
The agent's description says Pay vendor X 50.00
The canonical plan says 5000.00 to vendor Y
vectors.note: The approver sees the canonical plan; the agent text is shown only as an unverified note.

given: The tool's schema digest differs from its registry record
Tool invoke is allowed
Source read is allowed
Send to the destination is denied
vectors.note: One denied check denies the compound operation.

given: Two executions try to consume the same single-use approval at the same time
Remaining budget is 1000
Two concurrent reservations of 600 each
Dispatch times out
The downstream service offers no idempotency or reconciliation
vectors.note: No redispatch; the reservation stays.

given: A worker's lease expired while the invocation was DISPATCHING
A replacement worker picks it up
An UNKNOWN financial invocation is older than the tool's maximum hold age
A principal other than the requester records a failure verified by evidence
The original requester tries to resolve their own UNKNOWN financial invocation
An operator marks an UNKNOWN financial invocation ABANDONED without verified evidence of failure
vectors.note: The reservation stays charged and the approval stays consumed; redispatch is denied.

given: Same principal and unit
HTTP GET, MCP resources/read and the MCP read tool
vectors.note: S3 GET joins this set in R3.

given: An alias resolved to version 7
Version 8 is published before admission
vectors.note: Generation mismatch; the caller retries and resolves again.

given: Whole-document download is requested
The manifest has an unclassified attachment
The parent document allows read-units
The personnel unit is denied
A whole-document path is requested
An explicit unit-ID request mixes permitted and denied units
vectors.note: Generic denial; no content and no hint of which unit was denied.

given: The same selection is sent as an authorized-subset request
vectors.note: Permitted units only, no placeholders and no counts of hidden units.

given: An object key is renamed
The same principal is still allowed on the resource
vectors.note: Permission identity does not change with the alias.

given: Two writers stage versions against the same expected generation
The uploader's project membership is revoked between staging and commit
vectors.note: The blob stays staged for reconciliation; the object is not LIVE.

given: The process crashes after blob finalization and before catalog commit
vectors.note: Collected only after the grace period.

given: Manifest commit is interrupted after 3 of 5 units are committed
Garbage collection finds an old blob that a document manifest still references
vectors.note: The deletion does not run.

given: An authorized metadata query has 20 candidate units; no plaintext index is used
5 are denied to the caller
vectors.note: No total count; values and ordering depend only on the 15 permitted units. Page shape is not claimed to be noninterfering (SRH-004).

That client produces a model result with declared lineage including B
No recipient-specific declassify decision exists
vectors.note: The trusted client holds or discards its result; the server never receives the plaintext prompt or output. This does not apply to arbitrary dishonest clients.

given: A query result was cached for a user with broader rights
A user with narrower rights repeats the query
Publication of a unit that has no classification label
A client classifier workload proposes a lower label for a stored encrypted unit
vectors.note: Advisory until accepted by an authorized principal.

given: HEAD on an object that exists but is hidden from the caller
HEAD on an object that does not exist
vectors.note: Both return the same response.

given: A listing continuation token issued to principal P is replayed by principal Q
A delegation is revoked while a 200 MB ciphertext stream is in progress
vectors.note: Aborted at the next lease check, within T_check; bytes already sent are not recalled (N-01).

given: A decision is presented after its valid_until
The resource generation advances between decision and execution
An encrypted recipient-envelope delivery is retried after the grant was revoked
A candidate bundle fails compilation on an instance
vectors.note: The prior snapshot stays active and readiness is unchanged.

The optional managed-client profile is enabled; the runtime preserves its context and declared lineage
A different delegation, and so a different context key, starts work

given: A 200 MB ciphertext stream is in progress

given: The decision role's import graph contains the MCP SDK package

given: A request proposes one opaque recipient envelope whose declared context contains keys for two protected units
The recipient is authorized for only one unit
vectors.note: The baseline accepts one object/unit keyset per envelope. A batch is a container of independent envelopes; the server cannot split an opaque multi-unit bundle.

given: An authorized publishing client may read and share the version
The intended recipient fails its own read eligibility check
The publisher attempts to satisfy every check under its own principal
vectors.note: Target eligibility uses a separately resolved principal context and cannot be inherited from the publisher.

given: A valid grant requires metadata fields {id}; its obligation set is removed or widened without a new signature
Preparation succeeds for an otherwise valid publication before revocation
Revocation completes before the publication admission point; a previously prepared decision cannot publish
A read decision crosses the 17:00 policy cutoff without any revision changing
Restore a backup predating recipient revocation; fresh delivery remains closed until current revocations are reconciled
The derived stream is successfully admitted and its first lease check passes
A transitive source label rises while a derived-output stream is admitted; its dependency revision invalidates the lease
Delete a key, read its retained historical version, then explicitly withdraw that version
An unregistered client classifier cannot lower the authoritative label
A registered derived output inherits its source maximum with no managed-client flow service enabled
Historical content signed by a retired key verifies; a compromised binding without reviewed historical trust evidence fails closed
A native caller has no delegation or prior decision; authority-verifiable authentication evidence is supplied
An adapter then asserts another user without valid evidence for that user
A public decision caller lacks visibility of protected attributes referenced by policy outputs and obligation parameters
The internal response retains the full enforcement contract

given: Two retained document versions reuse one immutable unit with different manifest contexts
An authorized key-holding client supplies each context-bound descriptor and recipient envelope
vectors.note: Each authorized historical read succeeds with its own context; substituting the other context rejects. Recipient rotation and reclamation preserve live references.

given: A release manifest names no ceiling set and does not declare the ceiling set empty
vectors.note: A missing ceiling set is never treated as an empty one.

given: A condition uses request.now in arithmetic or compares it with an attribute instead of a timestamp literal
vectors.note: No sound next-change bound exists, so the bundle is rejected.
